declared_purpose: Draft, rewrite, shorten, polish and review Chinese official, business and news materials, and arrange Word documents using host document tools (SKILL.md:3-10; README.md:3-14).

data_operations.data_scope: Guidance selected by task, document genre, editing scope and format requirements.
data_operations.condition: Routing differs for short drafts, full drafting, review, exact replacement and formatting.

data_operations.operation: Read and transform user materials; conditionally retain factual working notes.
data_operations.source: Current effective materials, latest draft and user template.
data_operations.data_scope: Relevant original passages, figures, subjects, dates, quotations and factual states. Working notes exclude analysis and invented content.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Executing agent; internal checking records when needed.
data_operations.condition: Drafting and review require comparison with effective materials. Separate factual records are conditional on complex correspondence or repeated revisions; unavailable or prohibited tools and writes are skipped.

data_operations.operation: Generate personnel evaluations and inferred characteristics.
data_operations.source: Provided work, study, appraisal and investigation records.
data_operations.data_scope: Identity, role, performance, strengths, shortcomings and supported evaluations; formal cadre assessments may include political, integrity, personal-matter and disciplinary-check conclusions.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Draft or review returned to the requesting user.
data_operations.condition: Only the personnel-appraisal path. Characteristics must be tied to evidence; missing disciplinary information cannot establish absence of problems, and procedural conclusions require explicit records.

data_operations.operation: Search public sources and open source pages.
data_operations.source: Required writing conventions, user-specified verification questions or time-sensitive public facts.
data_operations.data_scope: Queries and page requests directed at necessary verification items; exact query contents are unspecified.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Host-selected search service and opened source websites; their identities are unspecified.
data_operations.condition: Unfamiliar writing requirements, explicit search requests or current facts trigger research. A sufficient official source ends that item's search; only one supplementary query is permitted for a qualifying gap or conflict.

data_operations.source: Retrieved public sources and verification results.
data_operations.data_scope: Source name, publisher, document number or link, publication date, access date or search scope, applicable location and verification status.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local source list; sources or verification explanations reach the user when requested or needed for the document.
data_operations.condition: Research path. Supplementary-source fields must come from the same actually opened page; missing fields remain gaps.

data_operations.operation: Locally read, count and scan draft text.
data_operations.source: Standard input or selected text and DOCX files.
data_operations.data_scope: Normally the complete proposed reply for scanning; counting follows the user's scope. Combined DOCX counting and scanning cover the main document; separate DOCX scanning covers additional document parts, including headers, footers, comments and notes.
data_operations.condition: Measured length, requested tool checks or specific mechanical checks are needed and tools are allowed. Standard input is preferred; ordinary drafting does not mandate disk scanning.

data_operations.operation: Return derived checking results to the caller.
data_operations.data_scope: Input path, counts, bounds, candidate findings and, with --outline, paragraph opening sentences, counts and proportions.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Standard output to the invoking caller; tool output serves as the local checking record. No additional log is required.
data_operations.condition: Helper invocation and selected flags. Results normally stay out of the final user response unless a checking report is requested; findings require contextual review.

data_operations.operation: Read complete selected source and draft files to locate explicit passages.
data_operations.source: User-selected UTF-8 TXT/MD material and draft paths, plus --literal arguments.
data_operations.data_scope: Full file contents are read locally. Output includes selected literals, every exact-match location, surrounding context of up to 24 characters on each side and both input paths.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: material_diff.py memory and standard output to its caller.
data_operations.condition: Optional original-passage location for multi-material or detailed checks; this performs location rather than factual verification.

data_operations.operation: Persist exact-edit inputs, generate a replacement file or compare an existing candidate.
data_operations.source: Complete original text, JSON replacement plan and optional candidate file.
data_operations.data_scope: Full original and generated text; old/new replacement passages and offsets; hashes, lengths and paths. Comparison failures return bounded expected/candidate difference context.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local original snapshot and plan files, edit_scope.py memory, a new TXT/MD output file when requested, and standard output to the caller.
data_operations.condition: Explicit replacement with all other text preserved. The documented procedure saves chat originals and plans before generation. Output creation is exclusive and preserves the original; --candidate compares without creating output. General no-save restrictions still apply.

data_operations.operation: Create or modify Word files while preserving document content and metadata-bearing structures.
data_operations.source: User document, template and authorized edits.
data_operations.data_scope: Body text, styles, sections, headers, footers, comments, revisions, footnotes, highlighting and hidden text. External-use versions require checking traces and author/organization properties.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Host document tool and a separately saved delivery version; original remains preserved by default.
data_operations.condition: Word or formal-formatting path. Preservation and separate saving are explicit procedures. Counts and relevant properties are reported for actual file delivery; the user decides removal, and the skill does not automatically delete traces or accept revisions.

data_operations.operation: Hand off complete material for independent review.
data_operations.source: Pending delivery message, supporting materials and current task scope.
data_operations.data_scope: Complete pending message and materials, together with the review scope.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Independent reviewer or reviewing component; identity, execution location and retention are unspecified.
data_operations.condition: Only when independent review is actually needed. The source does not establish that this recipient is external or that a handoff occurs on every task.

data_operations.operation: Screen and optionally redact delivered content.
data_operations.source: Drafts containing confidentiality markings, internal data or personal information.
data_operations.data_scope: Information retained, redacted or flagged according to the intended recipient and publication scope.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Requested draft, review response or delivery file returned to the user. Business addressees named in a draft are not shown receiving a transmission.
data_operations.condition: Sensitive-content screening applies before delivery. Classified markings trigger a recommendation for human confidentiality review; actual redaction depends on the task and publication scope.

data_operations.operation: Restrict temporary persistence and conditionally delete temporary files.
data_operations.source: Materials, responses and files created during the current task.
data_operations.data_scope: Necessary temporary files only; classified-marked or personally sensitive materials and responses must not be saved as temporary files, nor may user-prohibited content be saved.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: A task-specific subdirectory of the system temporary directory.
data_operations.condition: Files are used only when needed and must not overwrite existing files. Cleanup covers only current-task files no longer needed; restricted deletion stops and leaves files in place. This is a documented procedure, not an implemented cleanup routine in the supplied helpers.

potential_excess.data_scope: Supporting materials unrelated to the independently reviewed scope.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The independent reviewer or reviewing component receiving the handoff.
potential_excess.condition: Independent review is necessary, but the supplied material set contains unrelated content.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Review must evaluate the current deliverable within the user's scope. Handing over complete materials is an explicit workflow requirement, while that breadth is an implementation choice relative to the writing/review purpose.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide the complete pending delivery message, review scope and sufficient authoritative context to verify relevant claims.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Narrow supporting materials to relevant excerpts and their version, attribution and factual context. This reduces data in a necessary handoff rather than removing the review.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain complete materials where cross-document dependencies or full-scope review require them; expand context when an excerpt cannot support reliable checking.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete original text, replacement-plan passages and generated draft copies.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Temporary TXT/MD and JSON files on local disk.
potential_excess.condition: Exact replacement is requested as chat output, no durable artifact is needed, and the input is outside the existing no-save restrictions.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Exact editing requires faithful comparison and preservation outside the replacement scope. Disk snapshots are prescribed by the workflow and required by the current helper interface, but persistence is not intrinsic to that outcome.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Apply the explicit plan, validate ambiguity and overlap, and verify the complete resulting text against the original.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Add an in-memory or standard-input interface for the original and plan, and return the generated text without a temporary output file when file delivery is unnecessary.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve whitespace, line endings, hash binding, exact-scope verification and exclusive creation when a file is requested. Continue honoring the existing sensitive-content no-save rule.

unknowns: No execution trace or actual user document is supplied; operations and proposed excesses are conditional source findings.
Search tools, providers, exact queries, credentials, telemetry and retention are unspecified. This blocks determining whether research discloses private task details or excessive query content.
Host document tools are not supplied. Their network transfers, storage, retention and metadata-inspection coverage remain unresolved; end-to-end Word-file handling cannot be established.
The independent reviewer's identity, location, access boundary and retention are unspecified. A handoff cannot be classified as external disclosure from this source alone.

Physical storage and retention of source registers and tool records are unspecified. Cleanup is documented but not implemented by the supplied helpers, and deletion restrictions can leave temporary files behind.
The source does not establish whether retained Word comments, revisions, hidden text or author/organization properties are ultimately removed before any later external distribution.
